_comment: Core ambient-motion registry (themes-v2 P3). Each entry maps to static/motions/<id>/motion.js — an ES module default-exporting {id, name, mount(host, settings), unmount()}. settings.speed and settings.intensity carry the user's global multipliers. Served via /api/motions with the same validation floor as /api/themes; plugin motions ride capabilities.motions.

motions.name: Snow
motions.description: Falling flakes with a soft twinkle
